item.text:
**7B.1 Research Note: Olaf Scholz in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed, slightly positive on public candor and formal accountability, but not a clean yes. The strongest negative evidence is about Cum-Ex and alleged evasive answers, not a court finding that Scholz lied. I found no 2024 adjudication proving habitual deception.

**Evidence supporting truthfulness**
- **Taurus debate in the Bundestag** | *tagesschau.de* | 13 Mar 2024 | https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/scholz-regierungsbefragung-100.html | Scholz publicly repeated why he would not approve Taurus delivery, tying the refusal to German troop involvement; the article also records opposition accusations, so it shows both direct explanation and the existence of deception claims. | `7B.1`
- **Taurus refusal explained in government Q&A** | *Bundesregierung* | 4 Mar 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-fr/service/archives/chancelier-questions-2024-2265010 | Scholz gave a clear public rationale for the Taurus decision and framed it as a boundary on German involvement in the war, which cuts against concealment. | `7B.1`
- **Germany investigates eavesdropping on officers** | *Reuters* | 2 Mar 2024 | https://theprint.in/world/germany-investigates-eavesdropping-on-officers-after-russian-media-play-recording/1986474/ | After the intercepted-call leak, Scholz said the matter was serious and that it would be clarified quickly and carefully, which is consistent with a transparent crisis response rather than denial. | `7B.1`
- **Scholz requests confidence vote and cites citizens’ decision** | *Bundesregierung* | 13 Nov 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314 | Scholz publicly acknowledged the coalition break, said he would seek a confidence vote, and said citizens should decide the country’s direction. | `7B.1`
- **Scholz denies agenda-rigging and defends fair election timing** | *Reuters via Investing.com* | 8 Nov 2024 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828 | Reuters reported Scholz denied trying to ram through his own agenda and said the election timing should still allow a fair and democratic election. | `7B.1`
- **Bundestag records formal confidence procedure** | *Deutscher Bundestag* | 16 Dec 2024 | https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198 | The official record shows Scholz used the constitutional route to early elections rather than trying to bypass parliamentary rules. | `7B.1`

**Evidence undermining truthfulness**
- **Cum-Ex: 36 questions and “memory gaps” criticism** | *Stern* | 17 Sep 2024 | https://www.stern.de/politik/deutschland/cum-ex-affaere--wie-sich-olaf-scholz-durch-36-fragen-schummelt--35422102.html | The article says Scholz’s government gave evasive answers to a parliamentary question set and highlights opposition claims that the public and legislatures were not fully told the truth about his Warburg/Cum-Ex role. | `7B.1`
- **Hamburg committee: impression of staged memory lapses** | *WELT* | 8 Dec 2024 | https://www.welt.de/politik/deutschland/article254697766/U-Ausschuss-zu-Cum-Ex-Wie-sich-Scholz-gegen-den-Eindruck-vorgeschobener-Erinnerungsluecken-stemmt.html | Reporting on Scholz’s third Cum-Ex appearance says he again relied on “I have no memory” style answers, reinforcing suspicion that he was minimizing or evading. | `7B.1`
- **Cum-Ex scrutiny continues, but no clean resolution** | *tagesschau.de* | 5 Dec 2024 | https://www.tagesschau.de/investigativ/ndr-wdr/cum-ex-scholz-untersuchungsausschuss-100.html | The report shows the Cum-Ex inquiry was still active and contentious, with unresolved questions about political influence and Scholz’s role. This is weaker than a lie finding, but it is relevant to credibility concerns. | `7B.1`

**Counterweight to the negative case**
- **No criminal proceedings from complaints against Scholz** | *Deutscher Bundestag* | 31 Jul 2024 | https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1014366 | The government reported that several criminal complaints against Scholz had not led to investigations because there were no sufficient factual grounds. This does not prove truthfulness, but it undercuts claims of proven criminal deception. | `7B.1`

**Search gap**
- I did not find a 2024 court judgment or formal investigative finding proving that Scholz habitually lied to the public, parliament, courts, allies, or international partners.
- The strongest negative material is allegation-based, especially around Cum-Ex and perceived memory gaps, rather than adjudicated falsehood.
